label: DPI Control Identification
instruction: Confirm how DPI is changed: DPI button, software profile, onboard profile, or other.

label: DPI Stage Count
instruction: Cycle through available DPI stages and confirm the expected number of stages can be reached.

label: DPI Step Up / Cycle Behavior
instruction: Trigger DPI step/cycle several times. Confirm stages change in the expected order.

label: Unexpected DPI Reset Check
instruction: After several DPI changes, confirm DPI does not unexpectedly reset to a wrong/default stage.

label: DPI Indicator Check
instruction: If the mouse has a DPI LED/software indicator, confirm it matches the selected stage. Use SKIP if unavailable.
